summary.short: French excise-code article under which data-centre operators get a reduced excise rate on electricity above one gigawatt-hour per calendar year, if eight cumulative conditions are met (security, cooling, energy management, heat recovery, water use, electro-sensitivity). Amended by Law 2025-127 of 14 February 2025.
summary.long: Article L. 312-70 of the Code des impositions sur les biens et services (general excise regime) gives a reduced excise rate on electricity consumed for data-processing infrastructure, for the portion above one gigawatt-hour per calendar year. The rate applies only if eight cumulative conditions are met: data storage, processing, transport or distribution use; secured access; dedicated thermal, air-quality, power and fire-prevention controls; an energy management system; membership of a recognised good-practice programme (eco-design, efficiency, consumption reporting, cooling performance criteria); waste-heat recovery in a heat or cold network, or a multi-year power-efficiency indicator set by decree; cooling water use limited by a multi-year indicator set by decree; and electro-sensitive activities. The article itself sets no penalties. Its amendment by Law 2025-127 of 14 February 2025 is recorded in its version line.

relations.note: The version line states the article was modified by this law (art. 21, b du 7° du I (V)). The header also cites Conseil Constit. 2025-874 DC, which is not coded as a relation.

obligations.summary: Electricity for data-storage infrastructure qualifies for a reduced excise rate on the part of annual consumption above one gigawatt-hour only if eight cumulative conditions are met: secure access; dedicated thermal, air, power and fire controls; an energy management system; membership of a recognised best-practice programme with periodic reporting; heat recovery or a power-efficiency indicator; a water-use indicator for cooling; and electro-sensitive activities.
obligations.conditional_on: Electricity consumption exceeds one gigawatt-hour per calendar year and the eight cumulative conditions in points 1° to 8° are met.
